title: Leadership
summary: A product you drove, then three situations on influence, conflict and failure, with a director pushing back.

phases.title: Your product
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, the director joins later, then ask for a product they drove and are proud of. Probe what they decided, who they had to convince, and the result.

phases.title: Story one
phases.goal: Ask the card that targets what you know least about so far. Two to four probes, each built on the last answer.

phases.title: Story two
phases.goal: Next card, chosen the same way. Test scope for the level and how they handled the people who disagreed.

phases.title: Challenge
phases.goal: The lead asks a card about a hard call: saying no, a failed bet, or a decision that cost the team. After the candidate's first answer the director takes over, probes, and challenges the decision once, firmly, to see whether they hold or update with a reason.

phases.title: Your questions
phases.goal: Take one question, answer briefly, close and call end_round.
